Definition: to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate
BiblicalUsage: Kabash is treading down — to subdue, to conquer, to bring under foot. God gives it as the first charge to mankind, to subdue the earth; Joshua's generation sees the land subdued before them; and Micah promises that God will subdue our iniquities and cast our sins into the depths of the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dominion begins with God and ends with God. He gave us the earth to rule under Him, and He Himself subdues the one enemy we cannot — our own sin — and that is why the gospel, not our effort, is the ground of our freedom.
